SHORT CAUSE TRIAL
Off Calendar Oct-16-2012 Text Ruling
MINI MINUTES: This matter comes on calendar this day, having been assigned from the Dept. 206 for Settlement on the record.
Dept. 514, Judge: K. Tsenin, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Sonia Wong #11288.
Plaintiff James Soong present in pro per.
Peter Chao, Esq. for the Defendant Richard Galaxy Soong.
Case settled, defendant agreed to transfer his 18.4058% of the property known as 1318 Funston Ave., San Francisco to the plaintiff for financial, tax and title insurance purposes and to complete the issue on the grant deed and transfer of the title of the property.
Counsel to prepare a revised the stipulation to explained the Quit Claim deed and to indicates the promise to support the defendant until he reached the age of 21 years old, to be signed by the parties and submit to dept. 504 for signature.

10-16-12
Stipulation for entry of judgment was submitted and signed by Judge Tsenin.
